items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Well, my brother Larry started me off when I was a little kid.

ctx.x: 38. I never even knew about it. Uh, I wonder if you could tell us a little bit how you happened to take up clarinet. Was that your first instrument? Yeah.
Well, my brother Larry started me off when I was a little kid.
Did you use his horn at first? Yeah. I used Larry's horn.
